final: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM totals), kept AS (SELECT t.name, t.total_points, t.total_points - b.avg_total AS excess FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE t.total_points > b.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM kept) AS sum_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM kept AS k JOIN races AS r ON r.name = k.name JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.laps IS NOT NULL AND res.laps <> '' AND res.laps NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*') AS avg_laps, (SELECT AVG(excess) FROM kept) AS avg_excess
